scenarios.name: service_binpath_modification
scenarios.description: Real capture: sc.exe config points the Fax service's binPath at powershell.exe and sc start runs it from services.exe; the path is then restored.
scenarios.alert: Alert on WORKSTATION5: process sc.exe. Review this process and its related activity.
scenarios.label_note: Accepted: the service is started to run the command (T1569.002), the command is PowerShell (T1059.001), and the change is a registry write to the service's ImagePath (T1112).
